_about: Recent updates shown on the home page, newest first. Add a new item at the TOP of the 'items' list, copying the shape of '_example'. 'date' is year-month (2026-10) or year-month-day. 'link' is optional: leave it as an empty string if there is none. While 'items' is empty, the Recent updates section is hidden.

_example.text: New preprint on adaptive Big Five testing.
